title: Malted Milk Instant Pot Cheesecake
description: Easily prepared in your Instant Pot, this colorful malted milk candy cheesecake recipe with a graham cracker crust is perfect for the Easter holiday.
ingredients: 2 (8 ounce) packages cream cheese, at room temperature
0.33333334326744 cup egg-shaped malted milk balls (such as Whoppers® Robin Eggs), smashed

steps.text: Preheat the oven to 325 degrees F (165 degrees C). Line bottom and sides of a 7x3-inch springform pan with parchment paper.
Combine crushed graham crackers, melted butter, and 2 teaspoons sugar in a bowl; pat into bottom of the prepared pan.
Bake in the preheated oven until golden brown, about 10 minutes. Cool completely.

Beat cream cheese in a large bowl using a hand mixer until completely smooth. Beat in ½ cup sugar and vanilla until just incorporated. Add eggs, one at a time, beating until just combined. Add sour cream and malted milk powder; mix until combined, about 30 seconds. Stir in smashed malted milk candy using a rubber spatula until incorporated; pour batter into crust.

Pour 1 cup water into the bottom of a multi-functional pressure cooker (such as Instant Pot); add the trivet to the Pot, with the handles folded towards the bottom. Carefully place filled springform pan on the trivet. Close and lock the lid.
Select high pressure according to manufacturer's instructions; set the timer for 35 minutes. Allow 10 to 15 minutes for pressure to build.

Release pressure using the natural-release method according to manufacturer's instructions, about 15 minutes. Unlock and remove the lid, being careful not to let any condensation from the lid fall onto cheesecake; gently dab cheesecake surface with a paper towel to absorb any moisture if needed. Cheesecake should jiggle slightly when shaken. Leave cheesecake inside the Pot, uncovered, for 1 hour.
Chill cheesecake in the refrigerator for at least 2 hours, preferably overnight, before serving.
